response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack software engineer (15+ years) with strong web, backend, and some embedded/C-C++ exposure, but the role requires principal-level hardware architecture expertise: SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator performance analysis, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture, and hardware-software co-design. The resume shows no evidence of silicon modeling, deep-learning workload optimization, or computer architecture work, and the educational background (BS in CS, plus a fine arts degree) with no graduate-level architecture research does not offset the domain gap. The low-latency DLang microservices work at Sociomantic and the C/C++ work at National Instruments are the only tangentially relevant performance items, and they are software-level rather than architectural.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience, exceeding the BS+8yr bar
Demonstrated low-latency, high-throughput systems work (millions of req/s) in D and C/C++
Strong open-source, tooling, and technical-community/teaching track record
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, RTL, or computer architecture experience
No deep-learning training/inference or GPU/accelerator workload optimization background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack, not principal-level hardware IC work

key_factors.factor: Missing SoC/IP modeling and hardware architecture skills
No AI accelerator / deep-learning workload expertise
Extensive general software engineering and performance-oriented systems work
